verdict.rationale: Namecheap offers no native automation or agent feature in the evidence. It does provide building blocks that users can script into background jobs: an XML API with a sandbox, a Go SDK covering registration, renewal and registrar lock, a Terraform provider for DNS, and Dynamic DNS. With Dynamic DNS, an update client regularly refreshes the host IP over HTTPS. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or automation builder that runs autonomously, AI- or agent-driven background workflows, and any evidence of triggers or event-based automations beyond external scripts and clients.
